title: Brand-first marketing website workflow
objective: Run the Branding Website craftbook end to end and verify that its locked brand system and approved copy precede a complete responsive marketing page.
prompt: Use the Branding Website craftbook to build workspace `index.html` for Lumina Ledger, a calm bookkeeping service for independent design studios. The page must include a hero, three value propositions, a pricing/fit section, a primary CTA to book a cleanup call, and a footer. Lock the exact palette, type, section wireframe, and concise brand rules first; approve section-keyed copy second; only then build the self-contained responsive HTML with inline CSS and no external assets.

setup.about: Self-contained workflow eval for the Branding Website craftbook. Intermediate brand/copy deliverables belong in the artifacts drawer; the shipped page belongs at workspace/index.html.
setup.missionObjectives: Produce a brand-led one-page marketing site for Lumina Ledger with a locked palette and wireframe, approved copy, responsive HTML/CSS, primary CTA, and footer.

success.summary: The craftbook task records a concrete brand system and approved copy in artifacts before shipping a complete branded workspace/index.html.

axes.name: brand fidelity
axes.description: The final palette, typography, hierarchy, and section order visibly follow the locked brand system rather than a generic template.

axes.name: copy fidelity
axes.description: The page preserves the approved concise section copy and presents a clear primary action.

axes.name: responsive polish
axes.description: The layout remains legible and intentional at desktop and narrow widths without external dependencies.

axes.name: workflow evidence
axes.description: Brand and copy artifacts are substantive and align with what the final page actually ships.
